conventions.convention: The upper-strip boundaries are F(t)=ω(Aα_t(B)) and F(t+iθ)=ω(α_t(B)A). Rescaling α̃_τ=α_(τ/λ), with λ>0, multiplies the strip width by λ.
Minkowski signature is (-+++), x⁰=ct has length units, the right wedge is x¹>|x⁰|, and the future boost has positive off-diagonal sinh entries. The adopted bridge is Δ_W^(it)=U(Λ_W(-2πt)).
The QFT pairing is linear in its second argument; the modular pairing is ⟨u,v⟩₁=⟨v,u⟩₂. Consequently the two displayed vacuum-state formulas agree.
Cyclic-separating vacuum data and the modular/boost identity are adopted assumptions for the selected massive free scalar model. Continuum tensor factorization is not assumed.
Proper time τ is in seconds, η(γ̇,γ̇)=-c², and future rapidity is aτ/c. Physical-time strip width is ℏβ; T=(k_Bβ)^(-1).
The oscillator bases are indexed by ℕ₀, 0<z<1, pairings are second-variable-linear, and entropy uses the natural logarithm. The diagram's reduction map is defined only on scalar multiples of P_z.

load_bearing.statement: For the explicitly constructed massive scalar right-wedge algebra, assume Ω is cyclic and separating and adopt Δ_W^(it)=U(Λ_W(-2πt)) for every real t. No tensor-product factorization across the wedge and its complement is assumed.

Under Choice, for a normal state on a nonzero concrete von Neumann algebra and a point-ultraweakly continuous automorphism group satisfying the upper-strip boundary condition at dimensionless width θ>0, α̃_τ=α_(τ/λ), λ>0, remains point-ultraweakly continuous and satisfies that boundary condition at width λθ.

Conditional on Choice and the selected massive scalar wedge postulate, the future-boost action parametrized by the displayed proper-time orbit has upper-strip KMS width b_U=2πc/a seconds, β_U=2πc/(aℏ), and T_U=ℏa/(2πck_B). This asserts no detector response, particle production, thermal density matrix, or observed temperature.

seams_checked.note: Checked the consuming facts against the supplier statements and modular proof.
